breakfast.name: Churros con Chocolate
breakfast.description: Fried pastry served with thick hot chocolate for dipping
instructions: Bring water, sugar, oil to boil
Remove from heat, stir in flour until dough forms
Fry until golden on both sides
breakfast.notes: Churros must be served immediately while still warm
breakfast.fun_fact: Churros are typically eaten for breakfast with thick hot chocolate for dipping

lunch.name: Paella Valenciana
lunch.description: Saffron-infused rice with seafood, beans, and peppers cooked in wide shallow pan
instructions: Heat oil in wide paella pan
Add onion and garlic, cook until soft
Steep saffron in 1/4 cup warm broth
Add beans, tomato sauce, broth to pan
Don't stir (this develops the crispy bottom)
Simmer 20-25 minutes until rice is tender
lunch.notes: The crispy bottom layer (socarrat) is highly prized
lunch.fun_fact: Paella originated in Valencia, Spain and is THE national dish
alternatives: Bomba rice essential for authentic texture

dinner.name: Gazpacho (Cold Tomato Soup)
dinner.description: Refreshing cold tomato soup served as dinner starter in hot Spanish summers
instructions: Roughly chop tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, onion
Blend until mostly smooth (some texture preferred)
Top with croutons, egg, diced vegetables
dinner.notes: Can use food processor instead of blender
dinner.fun_fact: Gazpacho dates back to medieval Spain and Roman times

snacks.name: Tapas Spread
snacks.description: Small plates of Spanish appetizers including jamón, olives, cheese, and seafood
instructions: Make pan con tomate (bread rubbed with tomato and olive oil)
Serve at room temperature with wine
snacks.notes: Tapas are meant for sharing and grazing
snacks.fun_fact: The word tapas comes from 'tapa' meaning to cover or top

desserts.name: Flan (Crème Caramel)
desserts.description: Silky custard with caramel sauce, Spanish version of flan
instructions: Make caramel with sugar and water
Blend eggs, both milks, vanilla, cinnamon
Bake in water bath at 350°F for 40-45 min
desserts.fun_fact: Flan is eaten throughout Spanish-speaking world

drinks.name: Horchata de Chufa
drinks.description: Sweet drink made from tiger nuts, traditional Valencia beverage
instructions: Blend soaked tiger nuts with water
drinks.notes: Tiger nut milk difficult to find outside Spain
drinks.fun_fact: Horchata and churros is iconic Spanish snack pairing

drinks.name: Sangria
drinks.description: Wine punch with fresh fruit and brandy, perfect summer drink
drinks.notes: Better when made ahead for flavors to blend
drinks.fun_fact: Sangria is served throughout Spain especially in summer
